title.narrative: MIFTAH IRISH AID CORE FUNDING 24 PAL HRD 24

description.narrative: Funding of €100,000 to human rights NGO MIFTAH as a core contribution to support MIFTAH’s 2024 Work Plan and Budget for their activities in the occupied Palestinian territory (oPt). MIFTAH is the leading NGO in Palestine advocating for the empowerment of women and youth. Their strategy focuses on lobbying at the policy-making level, advocating for formulation of gender-responsive policies and budgets. As the Palestinian Initiative for the Promotion of Global Dialogue and Democracy, MIFTAH promotes the principles of democracy and good governance issues within Palestinian society. It delivers a number of programmes that seek to enhance the role of women in public life. Irish Aid has a longstanding relationship with MIFTAH through the provision of core support as part of our Human Rights and Democratisation Scheme. MIFTAH’s strategic focus for the period 2022-2026 is strengthening the rule of law and realizing the Palestinian aspiration of self-determination and independence.
